items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I think, yeah, I worked with Celestan one time, on Liberty at the St. Teresa Hall.

ctx.x: And Dave, Dave, what do you mean? Dave, that's all I know used to play. And Chani, used to play with Chani. I had a job at the last roundup, used to play with Chani and Po Re. I played so many different places at the last roundup, yeah, we used to play there, me and Chani and he's living here, Chani. Yes. I never did get to meet him. I saw him on the street once, about a half a block away somebody pointed him out but I
never did get to talk to him. He used to play with the tuxedo. Yes, Celestan and that group I think. Celestan.

Did you ever work with Celestan at any time? I don't see now. I think, yeah, I worked with Celestan one time, on Liberty at the St. Teresa Hall. Oh yeah. They had a hall build build in the yard. I worked with them there when their first created, when their first first opened. between Jackson and Phillip. I think they ought to be there now. I know they're still down.
